title: The Existence of God
definition: The existence of God means that God truly is. He is the living Creator, Sustainer, Judge, and Redeemer who has made Himself known through creation, conscience, Scripture, and ultimately through Jesus Christ.
summary: The Bible does not present God as a possibility to be guessed at, but as the eternal reality behind all things. Creation declares His glory, the human conscience bears witness to moral accountability, and Scripture reveals who He is and how sinners may know Him through Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ reveals the Father perfectly. To see Christ is to see the clearest revelation of the living God, not as a distant idea, but as the God who comes near to save.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God is not an idea, force, myth, or human invention. He is the living God who created all things and calls every person to know, worship, trust, and obey Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: If God exists, life has meaning, morality has foundation, worship has purpose, and every person is accountable to Him. The existence of God changes how we understand everything.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live before God with faith, reverence, gratitude, and trust. Seek Him through His Word, respond to Him through Christ, and remember that no life is hidden from His sight.
